column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key for each interaction record (e.g., 7001).
A BIGINT storing the article ID related to the interaction (non-FK).
A TIMESTAMP capturing when the interaction occurred (e.g., '2025-04-01 10:15:00').
An enum (eventtype_enum) describing the event (bookmark, click, scroll, share, view).
An INT for the event's sequence or position in the session (e.g., 3).
An enum (useragent_enum) describing the user agent (Desktop, App, Mobile, Tablet).
A TIMESTAMP specifically for when a click event happened (if applicable).
An enum (clickposition_enum) capturing the click position (1–10).
An enum (clicktype_enum) describing type of click (Related, Trending, Direct, Recommended).
An enum (clicksource_enum) referencing where the click originated (Article, Homepage, Search, External).
An enum (clickcontext_enum) capturing context of the click (Headline, Summary, Image, Author).
An enum (interactiontype_enum) describing the type of user interaction (Scroll, Share, Click, Hover).
